entities.name: Imperial Hospital and Research Centre Limited

operating_notes.text: ICRA reaffirmed long-term rating at [ICRA]AAA (Stable) and short-term at [ICRA]A1+ for ₹3,000 Cr facilities.
AHLL's Apollo Cradle runs 12 maternity centres and Apollo Fertility 20 fertility centres; Cloudnine runs 46 maternity, child and fertility centres.
The combined Apollo Cradle/Fertility-Cloudnine platform will have 55+ centres, backed by Temasek, True North, TPG and NewQuest, with AHLL the largest non-financial shareholder at 9.9%.
The resultant company Apollo Healthtech is to be renamed Apollo Healthco Limited on effectiveness, with a 12-member board including 6 independent directors.

timeline.summary: Apollo Hospitals received an NCLT order modifying dates for convening meetings for its composite scheme of arrangement.

On 8 May 2026 Apollo Hospitals reported an NCLT Chennai order of 5 May 2026 resetting the scheme meetings of secured creditors, unsecured creditors and equity shareholders to 23-25 June 2026, with the 26 March 2026 quorum unchanged.
ICRA reaffirmed Apollo Hospitals' long-term credit rating at [ICRA]AAA (Stable) and short-term rating at [ICRA]A1+ for ₹3,000 Cr bank facilities.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,605.5 Cr (+18.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹529.3 Cr (+35.9% YoY).
Apollo Hospitals clarified turnover and net worth figures for subsidiaries ASHPL and AFCPL.

On 20 May 2026 Apollo Hospitals' subsidiary AHLL agreed to combine its Apollo Cradle and Apollo Fertility verticals with Cloudnine (Kids Clinic India), valuing them at ₹1,550 Cr in cash plus a 9.9% stake in a 55+ centre combined platform, subject to CCI approval.

On 21 May 2026 Apollo Hospitals issued the notice for a 24 June 2026 equity shareholders' meeting, with a 17 June 2026 e-voting cut-off, to vote on the composite scheme among Apollo Hospitals, Apollo Healthco, Keimed and Apollo Healthtech, still subject to NCLT sanction.
On May 25, 2026, Apollo Hospitals filed the transcript link for its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 21, 2026.
Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited schedules Analyst/Institutional Investor Meeting on 17-19 Nov 2026 at various locations.
